notes: C6 asks for inverse-FT real-space maps of each 1/2 Q_Bragg component over the full FOV of Figs. 3a,c; P23 asks for full-FOV sliding-window maps of the three 1/2 Q_Bragg directional intensities across Figs. 3a,c, which is mathematically equivalent and solves the same problem (marked 'raised'). C7 argues the finite-q 1/2 Q_Bragg domains break translational symmetry and should be called smectic; P7 notes the contradiction between claiming 'q = 0 electronic nematicity' and measuring finite-q 1/2 Q_Bragg modulations labeled Q_CDW, without calling the state smectic (marked 'partly'). C10 questions whether the broad 1/2 Q_Bragg peaks could be short-range/fluctuating CDW; the review accepts QPI as plausible but asks for the same quantitative DFT energy-window comparison (P24) and temperature dependence (P20/P6) (marked 'partly'). C2 and C4 are partly raised in P24 via the requests to discuss any rigid Fermi-level shift and the doping mismatch (x=0.25 vs x=0.33) in the DFT M-pocket analysis. P9 and P15 are bare section headers extracted as points.
